bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
f="$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
if grep -Fq '"link_inline_query_smoke"' "$f"; then echo INLINE_ACTION_SOURCE=YES; else echo INLINE_ACTION_SOURCE=NO; exit 71; fi
if grep -Fq 'if action == "link_inline_query_smoke":' "$f"; then echo INLINE_HANDLER_SOURCE=YES; else echo INLINE_HANDLER_SOURCE=NO; exit 72; fi
echo INLINE_ACTION_PRESENT=PASS
